package.name: xnero_mujoco_sim
package.description: MuJoCo stand-in for xnero hardware drivers: replaces the XHand serial driver (/left_hand|xhand_command → xhand_state, incl. per-point tactile forces) and accepts kinematic arm commands from nero_teleop in sim_mode. Hands are simulated with real physics; arms are kinematic overrides.
